top_signals.title: Tender-Assist Rigs: Southeast Asia’s Quiet Workhorses Head for Full Utilization
top_signals.summary: Often overshadowed by the towering jackup and ultra-deepwater floating rig fleets that dominate offshore headlines, tender-assist rigs are enjoying a resurgence in Southeast Asia. While they represent a relatively small niche of the global offshore drilling market…
